content: Xammaqiza Waannisa Sibikate

Kaatay Xibaaroosa Oroome biittal kawutin, taphpho ichchintho laythar, Phenxxe Philaaxoosa Yihuda aqisiza layithi Herodoosa Galila aqisiza layithi e isha Filphoosa Ixuurasannee Xirakkonddoosa aqisiza wode Lisanoosa Abilaanisana aqisiza wode
Haannarannee Qayyaafara qeese halaqa maaqqii yezin, Xooss qaalay Zakkireesa na7a Waannisako liizho gadha ye7eeza.
Waannisa, «Yi nagaraypp maaqqoyttannee xammaqinttoytta. Xoossay yi nagara atto goda» yeegii tamaarssittar Yorddanoosa borkka heera yez biitta ubba yhanigeeza.
Yeykka nabe Isiyaasa fa maxaafayid,
gi xaafintteezay haneeza.
Waannisa, e kusher xammaqinttodayis ye7eez gaame asayiko, «Yinttano, shooshii na7untho ye7odayis yez bochaypp buuttod garkk yinttan zoreezay oonoo?
Yikkee, yi maaqqitha beeziza lo77o ooso oothoytta, yi wozinar, ‹Nuus, nu aday Afiraame yeza gi gaayirppatte.› Yhana si7oytta, yha shuchchitaypp Xoossay Afraames na7a kessodays danda7iza.
Yeezako, gande minxxayis xaphayid yeza. Yikkee, lo77o aafe aafowa mith ubbitay gachinttii tama gancce wodhdhoda» yeegeeza.
Asay, «Yeezin nuunii ab ootho?» yeegii oyceeza.
Waannisa mahii, «Nam77ii afila yeza asii baazayis inggo. Katha yezay baazayis shago» yeegeeza.
Qaraxe gachisizitay xammaqinttodayis yi7ii, «Asitamaarayyo, nu ab udo?» yeegeeza.
E mahii, «Yinttan kiitteezanpp aathii ekkipate» yeegeeza.
Ma wotaaddaritay yi7ii, «Nu abi udo» yeegii oyiceeza. Waannisa, «Obazikka wolqqar dafi ekkippate, oonakka worddor mootippate, yi damoozay yinttis gidoda» yeegeeza.
Asay Kiristtoosa ufayisar naagttar yeza gisho Waannisa, «E Kiristtoosa maaqqadeshshaa?» yeegii u fa wozinayid qoppiza.
Waannisa ubbitayis mahii, «Taanii yinttan haathar xammaqiza, Zin taapp aadhii wolqqamizay ye7oda. Taanii e caammay wodora billodayis beezooya asii. E yinttan geeshsha Ayyanarannee tamar xammaqoda.
Wudumma yez katha geeshshodayis pithay e kushayid yeza. Geezheez katha fa shaalayid qoloda; bunnana dhaboowa tamar xuuggoda» yeegeeza.
Ma Waannisa asa gaame zore zorii Wongile
sabbakeeza.
Zin Waannisa Herodoosa fa ishay machchat, Heroodiyada, ekkeez gishonnee hara iita oosita ootheez gishos kacceez wode
Herodoosa kasesayil afa hara iita baz ubba gujjii Waannisana woyne geliseeza.
Yesuusa xammaqintto
Woyay ubbay xammaqqintteezaypp guye, Yesuusakka ma xammaqintteeza. E woossodar salo dooyintteeza,
Geeshsha Ayyanay holle garkke maaqqii ezal afa wodhdheeza. Salopp «Taanii qadhdhiza na7ay nena; ne tana ufayssiza yeegiz» qaala ye7eeza.
Yesuusa yeletith xuss
Yesuusa taamarsso aykkiz wode ees hasttam laythi zini, asay eza Yooseefa na7a gi qoppeeza.

content.text: Maate Lewe na7a, Lewe Milkka na7a,
Milkka Yoona na7a, Yoona Yooseefa na7a,
Yooseefa Mataate na7a, Mataate Amoxe na7a,
Amoxe Nahoome na7a, Nahoome Asiliime na7a,
Ma7aate Mataatiye na7a, Mataatiye Samaye na7a,
Samaye Yooseefa na7a, Yooseefa Yooda na7a,

content: Yooda Yoonanne na7a, Yoonanne Rase na7a,

footnotes.text: Wongile: Girike doonar Wongile giz qaalay gaame ufayssiza oda woy mishiraachcho guussii. Ye mishiraachchaykka Kiristtoosa as kochchii ubba medhina pirddepp ashshodayis kiitinttii ye7eez gaame ufayssa (Luqa 1:19; 2:10)
